notes: Two branches meet at «قالا حدثنا»; «عن سالم، عن ابن عمر» is written once after the last «ح» and is the shared tail
Branch 2 names «سفيان» and «الزهري» after «قالا»; branch 1 names Ibn Uyayna and Zuhri. The tail is read as starting at Salim, so the two branches are not forced through the same Sufyan
«- واللفظ لهما -» is an editor's gloss, left out
